breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly treats the internal torque as piecewise constant rather than uniform over the whole shaft. It explicitly divides the shaft into two segments (x: 0→400 mm and x: 400→1200 mm), computes separate internal torques for each segment using the free-body-diagram method (T_internal_1 = +200000 N·mm for the segment from 400 to 1200 mm, and T_internal_2 = 0 N·mm for the segment from 0 to 400 mm), and uses these distinct values for both the shear stress and angle of twist calculations. This directly contradicts and corrects the flawed instruction in the incomplete prompt that said to 'take a single internal torque equal to the algebraic sum of the applied torques over the full length.'
